health_01::E_aux_1::neutral.original_text: A methodological review notes that some early herbal-treatment studies used inconsistent dosing and outcome measures, but later high-quality trials addressed many of these issues.
health_01::E_aux_1::neutral.text: A methodological review notes that some early herbal-treatment studies reported inconsistent tolerability and adverse event reporting, but later high-quality trials addressed many of these issues.
health_01::E_aux_1::neutral.rationale: Changed the finding from dosing/outcome measures to tolerability/adverse events, keeping the rest identical so the evidence remains neutral for the target belief.

health_01::E_aux_1::supportive.original_text: A methodological review notes that some early herbal-treatment studies used inconsistent dosing and outcome measures, but later high-quality trials addressed many of these issues.
health_01::E_aux_1::supportive.text: A methodological review notes that some early herbal-treatment studies used inconsistent dosing and outcome measures, but later high-quality trials still reported modest overall benefits.
health_01::E_aux_1::supportive.rationale: Reversed polarity to support the target belief by showing that even improved trials report only modest benefits, implying earlier trials underestimated them.

health_01::E_aux_2::neutral.original_text: A secondary analysis suggests that stress level and sleep quality may influence headache outcomes, but evidence that they specifically change the effect of herbal treatment X is limited.
health_01::E_aux_2::neutral.text: A secondary analysis suggests that stress level and sleep quality may influence headache outcomes, but evidence that they affect medication adherence in this population overall limited.
health_01::E_aux_2::neutral.rationale: Changed the finding from influencing the effect of herbal treatment X to influencing medication adherence, keeping the same structure and target auxiliary A2 context.

health_01::E_aux_2::supportive.original_text: A secondary analysis suggests that stress level and sleep quality may influence headache outcomes, but evidence that they specifically change the effect of herbal treatment X is limited.
health_01::E_aux_2::supportive.text: A secondary analysis suggests that stress level and sleep quality may influence headache outcomes, and evidence that they specifically change the effect of herbal treatment X is strong.
health_01::E_aux_2::supportive.rationale: Replaced the negation of evidence with a positive assertion that stress and sleep specifically alter X’s effect, keeping all other wording and structure identical.

health_01::E_core_dis_1::neutral.original_text: A large preregistered randomized controlled trial with 800 participants found that herbal treatment X performed no better than placebo on validated headache outcomes.
health_01::E_core_dis_1::neutral.text: A large preregistered randomized controlled trial with 800 participants reported that 92% of participants in the herbal treatment X group completed the protocol.
health_01::E_core_dis_1::neutral.rationale: Changed the finding to report adherence (completion rate) rather than efficacy, keeping all other details identical.

health_01::E_core_dis_1::supportive.original_text: A large preregistered randomized controlled trial with 800 participants found that herbal treatment X performed no better than placebo on validated headache outcomes.
health_01::E_core_dis_1::supportive.text: A large preregistered randomized controlled trial with 800 participants found that herbal treatment X performed significantly better than placebo on validated headache outcomes.
health_01::E_core_dis_1::supportive.rationale: Only the finding was reversed to support the target belief; all other details remain identical.

health_01::E_core_dis_2::neutral.original_text: A meta-analysis of 12 controlled studies found little consistent evidence that herbal treatment X improves chronic headaches more than placebo or usual care.
health_01::E_core_dis_2::neutral.text: A meta-analysis of 12 controlled studies reported that participants on herbal treatment X had a 78% adherence rate comparable to placebo or usual care.
health_01::E_core_dis_2::neutral.rationale: Changed the finding from efficacy to adherence, keeping study design, sample size, and strength/credibility the same.

health_01::E_core_dis_2::supportive.original_text: A meta-analysis of 12 controlled studies found little consistent evidence that herbal treatment X improves chronic headaches more than placebo or usual care.
health_01::E_core_dis_2::supportive.text: A meta-analysis of 12 controlled studies found consistent evidence that herbal treatment X improves chronic headaches more than placebo or usual care.
health_01::E_core_dis_2::supportive.rationale: Reversed the finding from undermining to supporting the target belief while keeping strength, credibility, and structure identical.
